summary.text: Jina Petrarca-Karampetsos is an independent candidate for the Rhode Island State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2016.

paragraphs.text: Jina Petrarca-Karampetsos won the 2016 Democratic primary for Rhode Island State Senate District 17, defeating Dennis Lavallee, Keven McKenna and Hagop Setrak Jawharjian.
She lost the 2016 general election to Republican Thomas Paolino, 49.00 percent to 51.00 percent.
In 2026 she is on the ballot as an independent in a race that also includes Paolino, now the incumbent, Democrat Nelly Burdette and independent John Douglas Barr II.
